concerns.text: FR-002 mandates subsampling by retaining the 'largest connected component' (LCC) if limits are exceeded. The tasks introduce a 'Degree-Based Subsampling' fallback (T008b) and an 'Authorization' task (T008c) for this fallback. While the Plan.md authorizes this deviation, the tasks do not explicitly link this deviation to the Plan's 'Plan Deviation' section or the Spec's 'Assumptions' regarding statistical power. This creates a semantic gap where the task implements a relaxation of the FR without the required traceability to the authorized deviation, risking silent constraint weakening.

FR-006 explicitly mandates 'Wilcoxon signed-rank tests'. The tasks implement 'Permutation Tests' (T030b) as a deviation. While T030a documents the justification, the task list does not explicitly state that this deviation is a 'Plan Deviation' authorized by the Plan.md. Without this explicit linkage in the task description, the task appears to be a silent relaxation of FR-006 rather than an authorized implementation of a plan deviation, violating the constraint preservation principle.

FR-001 mandates ingestion from the 'CTU-13 dataset'. The tasks (T007a, T007b) implement a fallback to 'NF-BoT-IoT-v3' if CTU-13 fails. While the Plan.md authorizes this, the tasks do not explicitly cite the 'Plan Deviation' or 'Assumptions' section that permits this substitution. This risks a silent weakening of the data source constraint (FR-001) without the required traceability to the authorized deviation.
